fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) has risen approximately 1,010% over the past five years driven by surging AI infrastructure demand, with fiscal 2026 Q4 (ended September 3) revenue reaching $54.2 billion, up 380% YoY.
fields.summary_ko.1: Micron holds strong market share of 18% in HBM and 21% in DRAM, with SK Hynix management having already sold half of anticipated production for 2027–2028 and expecting current demand levels to persist through 2030.
fields.summary_ko.2: Due to high cyclicality of the memory business, there is concern that favorable gross margins currently around 81% could decline if demand weakens.
